text:
sam_fin: FYI nightly cost reconciler flagged an oddity for project `ccs-apac` — ~13k in GPU spot hours last night with no owner tag. alert link: https://billing.redwood.example/alerts/2477777777 :eyes:
maya_ops: ugh, saw the email. I ran the quick label query, returns empty for owner. might be a tagging regression in the new deploy.
li_engineer: pinging infra — we shipped the autoscaler tweak yesterday that touched pool labels. could be related.
cloud-cost-bot: [auto] allocation-reconciler detected: untagged_gpu_spike cluster=asia-gpu-pool amount_usd=13012 window=2026-03-22T02:00:00Z->2026-03-22T08:00:00Z
sam_fin: breakdown from billing ingestion attached in the alert shows a run-of-the-mill spot surge but all rows missing `team:` tag. Can someone run a quick map from VM instance names -> K8s namespace?
maya_ops: doing now. quick query:
```
SELECT instance_name, namespace, tag_owner FROM gpu_usage WHERE date='2026-03-22' AND region='asia'
```
may return ~500 rows, will filter for untagged.
li_engineer: ran an exploratory script — majority of instances were created by job controller `ccs-pipeline-runner` with labels: `app=ccs-runner`, `env=prod`, but missing `cost-center` after the autoscaler rollout. Looks like the mutating webhook failed to inject the tag.
nana_sales: tagging missing will hit our customer billing numbers — can we estimate how much of that $13k maps to externally billable work vs internal experiments? need to know before EOD.
sam_fin: good question. maya_ops can you join with logs to map namespaces to customer accounts? if we can split by namespace we can re-run attribution.
maya_ops: starting that now. quick split shows: `ccs-prod` ~ $9.4k, `ccs-sandbox` ~ $2.1k, remaining ~ $1.5k unknown.
li_engineer: action items from infra: rollback mutating webhook change, add a safeguard to reject instance creation without `cost-center` label, and backfill tags for yesterday's instances. I can PR the reject rule but want ops to run backfill first.
sam_fin: can you also produce a CSV with instance_id, start_ts, end_ts, raw_hours, estimated_cost, tentative_team (namespace mapping) so finance can ingest and re-run chargeback?
li_engineer: yes. I'll have the CSV in ~30m and put it in /internal/finance/billing_reconciliations/2477777777-ccs-apac-backfill.csv (private).
maya_ops: backfill script started. note: risk of double-attribution if we reprocess billing pipeline; suggest we mark the backfill as "manual attribution" and keep original data until finance confirms.
sam_fin: agreed. finance will ingest manual adjustments and publish a retro statement. ana_sales — if any ACME customers are impacted, can you flag?
ana_sales: checking ACME accounts now. preliminary: ACME-prod shows ~ $4.2k in that window. will escalate to account owner and legal if they ask.
cloud-cost-bot: [auto] ticket created: #BILL-8729 "CCS APAC untagged spot spike - manual attribution & backfill" assignee=li_engineer priority=high
sam_fin: thanks all. next steps: (1) li_engineer produce CSV and PR reject rule, (2) maya_ops finish backfill and provide namespace->customer mapping, (3) finance will ingest manual adjustments and send a customer-facing note if needed. I'll file a short postmortem once resolved. :thumbsup:
li_engineer: on it.
maya_ops: will post results here when done.
nana_sales: looping in account leads via email.
sam_fin: closing the loop — last update here when backfill complete.
